ex4.description: EX4 web interface. A login with `read ex4` may look; with `write ex4` it may also change settings. No method here can write the array, a partition table or the flash, run a command of the caller's choosing, or read a file of the caller's choosing. `session destroy` is sign-out: the web server puts the caller's own session id into every call, so a session can only end itself.
